text:
Estimates: the meal is a turkey wrap cut in half, with lettuce, tomato, carrot and a tortilla, plus a glass of dark soda (probably cola).

Wrap: about 350 kcal, with roughly 22 g protein, 35 g carbohydrate and 14 g fat.

Soda: about 12 oz of cola at about 140 kcal and 36 g carbohydrate. The glass in the second photo is empty apart from a little liquid, so I counted nearly all of it as drunk.

Served total: about 490 kcal.

Leftovers: only wrapper plastic and a few bits of lettuce remain, so I put leftovers at about 15 kcal.

Eaten: 490 − 15 = 475 kcal. Protein is about 21 g. Carbohydrate is about 35 + 36 − 1 = 70 g. Fat is about 13 g.
